body:
Compute admission currently learns Plan workspace after KV admission, which can leave ready Compute nodes blocked with no active work. This checkpoint adds a compile-only C++/C ABI envelope over every actual mapping candidate, a real ctypes client, an optional immutable LRU fit floor, and bounded pressure diagnostics. Scheduler activation remains pending complete manifest coverage and store/migration source-release ordering.

The canonical library is published to five repositories. This branch includes the user's new JOINT baseline fecf81c; only the pure library is added to new JOINT, and its config-test isolation is corrected. The archived JOINT directory is untouched and its prior business results are not reused.

Validation: public 30/30; 62 existing hashes/full summaries identical; 224 real legacy queries plus 16 expected rejects, with complete new-ABI replay; client 11/11; manager-related 57/57; online 154 passed/1 optional-oracle skip and hardware/config/scheduler 44/44; five ABI pairs built and config 83/83; four Online rebuilds and focused 18/18.

The user requested immediate handoff and stop. HANDOFF records all effective source/binary identities, preserved OS solo13 baseline and partial profiling/sanitizer failure, unapplied source-release prototype (41 existing + 5 new tests/OFF byte equivalence), and an unexecuted manifest-envelope draft. No production timing accuracy, TX8 target fit, host-budget pass or new JOINT coarse business integration is claimed. All agents are frozen; merge and remote ancestry confirmation complete the handoff.
title: Add exact workspace envelopes and preserve simulator handoff
head: codex/die-workspace-envelope-20261014
